title: M7.P5: Qualify same-model settings restore on the next candidate
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

The installed-image criterion is complete on replacement19: actual writer/upload/scan/restore selects the newest compatible same-model archive despite a newer foreign archive; downloaded SHA and journal match. Paired offered/foreign-only640×480 frames, exact inventories and unchanged foreign-case settings hashes are in [installed UI/source evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-installed-ui). This is replacement19 execution, with unchanged cloud/ES bytes proved in the19→20 comparison. The public explanation criterion remains OPEN under #511; this issue stays open.

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

## Current scope — remaining settings-restore proof

D-CLOUD-162/164 remains: restore this **device model label's** newest compatible cloud settings archive. The row names `<DEVICE>, <DATE>` or is dimmed with `NO SETTINGS BACKUP FROM THIS DEVICE YET`. Local recovery has its own compatibility rules; no cross-model cloud choice is added.

Replacement18 scripts.log records all13 T24 writer→scan→restore, archive-layout and foreign-label controls passing. Its composed standard UI proof includes the dimmed row. This proves specific source/runtime predicates; it is not the exact offered/foreign fixture/frame pair required below. #381's writer-shaped discovery fix is already delivered.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Writer-shaped/current/legacy/flat/foreign archive controls pass: replacement18 scripts.log T24-production-backup-scan-restore through T24-foreign-renamed, 13 PASS/0 FAIL.
- [x] Canonical menu states and current dimmed settings presentation are retained in docs/es-menu-map.md and #527's composed standard frame proof.
- [x] On the next installed candidate, retain paired640×480 offered `<DEVICE>, <DATE>` and foreign-only disabled-row frames, with exact same-model/foreign fixture inventories, selected archive/journal and unchanged foreign-case settings hashes. Bind to the image/source manifest.
- [ ] Publish the same-model/newest/disabled-state explanation with #344/#511 release/setup documentation; cite the retrieved page or docs change.

Opening scan text and its current failure/second-scan sequences belong to #350, not a stale proposed copy approval or automatic folder-discovery requirement.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Retained synthetic proof is reviewed here; any missing software assertion belongs on the next combined candidate. No personal cloud or owner-device action.

[Disposition and next-build plan](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md); [replacement18 qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md).


## Original request and history

The complete original body and every comment are preserved in [the #533 snapshot](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-candidate-scope/tracker-before.json), entry #349. Retired criteria there are historical, not an execution queue. Existing GitHub comments also remain intact.
